title: Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief on Credit Builder Accounts
content:
## The relief

An early-closure late-fee relief is granted without a request when a borrower with a pending early-closure request still owes the account's most recent late fee, and is booked as a courtesy waiver that counts toward the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months but is granted however many have already been granted on the account; a goodwill credit on a late fee, a returned-payment fee relief once its payment has been made good and an early-closure returned-fee relief each follow their own rule, and any other courtesy waiver is still granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.

Being granted without a request, the early-closure late-fee relief is not held to the fee waiver request window, whatever the fee's age, and the early-closure returned-fee relief and the made-good relief are likewise governed by their own rules; every other courtesy waiver must still be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

The early-closure late-fee relief is not figured until the account's oldest unpaid due date, once its grace period has ended with the installment still unpaid, carries its late fee, unless that late fee comes to 0.00.

While the account has a pending early-closure request, this relief takes priority over a goodwill credit on the same late fee, and no goodwill credit is granted on that fee.

| Credit Builder account facts | Early-closure late-fee relief |
|---|---|
| an early-closure request pending confirmation, and the borrower still owes the most recent late fee | granted, with no request from the borrower and whatever the fee's age |
| courtesy waivers already granted on the account up to the plan's number | still granted; the relief counts toward that number |
| no pending early-closure request | this relief does not arise |

## Booking the relief: `relieve_late_fee_at_closing_c21c573e`

**What it does.** The tool grants the early-closure relief on one late fee of a Credit Builder account. It books a fee waiver entry with the courtesy basis, dated today and linked to the late fee it relieves, and lowers the account's unpaid fees by the relief. The borrower sees the relief and the lower unpaid-fee balance on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `relieve_late_fee_at_closing_c21c573e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the late fee entry being relieved, as listed among the account's entries by the Credit Builder entry lookup |
| `relief_amount` | the relief in USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Early-closure relief <entry reference> of <amount> USD booked on <account reference> against fee <entry reference>; unpaid fees now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this text means the relief is on the account.
